notes.title: May 11th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Tourists…

We’ve got another set of fixes coming your way, in particular taking care of a few lingering crashes that still remain. You should now be able to battle through NOLA with much less fear of a sudden stop (other than from a walker bite, of course).

The details are listed below…
-
[b]Fixed CRASH when using blunt weapons and objects as weapons.
Fixed CRASH when dismembering specific character models.
Fixed CRASH when equipping Sap Gloves.
Fixed weapon-jitter when holding weapons.[/b]

notes.title: April 19th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Tourists,

We are happy to bring you the latest, and largest, patch for Chapter 2! This should fix a majority of reported problems, bring in more quality of life improvements, and fix the lingering achievement issues players have run into.

We encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts with us so we can continue to improve the game where we can. 

You can see the full patch notes below.


[b][STEAM ONLY] [/b]
Users have the option of using the DirectX 12 mode for [i]Retribution[/i]; however, this is a late production cycle feature, so it may not work perfectly with all PC configurations.  We encourage players to manually change from DirectX 11 to 12 and see how the game performs. Our tests showed significant improvement in some cases, but it is heavily depending on your current hardware configuration, so results may vary from system to system.  To adjust the DirectX setting, put “-dx12” into the Steam app launch parameters.

[b]Critical Fixes[/b]
-All Achievements are now properly unlockable.
-[i]PROGRESSION BLOCKER FIX[/i] - Players who died in Speakeasy AFTER completing the optional mission during “His Will Be Done” will no longer be stuck.
-[i]PROGRESSION BLOCKER FIX[/i] - Players who left the area before completing the “Hunting the Hunter” mission will no longer be stuck.
-Escape moment at the end of “Off on the Wrong Foot” improved.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
-Floating flare at the front of the bus in The Resting Place map has been removed.
-Barks during “Hunting the Hunter” combat have been tuned.
-[i][LOCALIZATION][/i] Subtitles for Walkie-Talkie now translated.
-[i][LOCALIZATION][/i] Wording on the whiteboard of tutorial is no longer truncated.
-Difficulty mode can now be changed via the pause menu.
-Fully reloading sawed-off shotgun missing only one bullet now possible.
-Grenades are easier to pick up.
-Fixed some collision issues on maps during “Bigger Fish to Fry” mission.
-Journal task update fanfare will now trigger consistently.

[b]General Visual Fixes[/b]
-Removed some visual artifacts. 
-Fixed floating locker in Rampart. 
-Fixed some countertops being blacked out.
-Fixed some disappearing buildings in Tower Approach.
-Improved texture assets in areas.
-Fixed a few “out of world” visibility areas.
-Fixed posters incorrectly positioned.
-Beretta and M4 muzzle flash with suppressor added.
-Floating unnecessary UV cats reduced.
-Placeholder decals replaced.
-Fixed the disappearing assets in some cases.
-Improved elevator doors animation.

[b]Character Visual Improvements[/b]
-Reduced NPC models breaking.
-Dismembered NPCs visuals improved.
-Bad walker severing visual artifacts reduced.
-Floating heads next to NPCs removed.
-Dead bodies in hotel no longer completely blacked out.

[b]Lighting Improvements[/b]
-Improved interior lighting in areas
-Updated Pawnshop and Speakeasy with Godrays
-Fixed some flashlight shadows
-Adjusted fog effects on maps

Hello Tourists!

Thank you!

notes.title: PC Hotfix 4 320505
notes.notes:
Hello Tourists!

We have another set of hot fixes coming out today for Retribution! For PC players, this should take care of some recent problems you might be running into.

The specifics are listed below!
[list]
[*] Oculus players using Virtual Desktop and Pico will be able to launch on SteamVR
[*] Angel Statues no longer missing from imported save games
[/list]

As always, more hot fixes and larger updates are on the way, so be sure to continue reporting any issues you’re running into.

notes.title: Chapter 2 Hot Fix 1 - CL317896
notes.notes:
[b][u]PC CH2 HOT FIX 1 - CL317896[/u][/b]

Hello Tourists! 

The full patch notes are listed below.

[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Orphan Bow Recipe should now appear correctly for Imported Saves
[*] Resolved a potential progression issue where the journal would not update if the player visited Sonny before being called for “A One Stop Shop”.
[*] Improved LOD settings for Mid - Ultra settings
[*] Fixed a potential crash when attacking with the Chainsaw
[*] Performance improvements for some configurations
[/list]

[b]Please Note[/b]
Verify the your video settings before playing, sometimes the auto detect feature will place all settings at Ultra on first install

notes.title: Retribution Is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello again, Tourists! 

The wait is finally over. [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Chapter 2: Retribution[/i] is now live on Steam, and now you can continue your Tourist's journey as you face off against The Axeman and the Tower. 

Alongside the base game, you can pick up the [i]Payback Edition[/i] to receive "The Blessing" Weapon Recipe, the "Fat Tuesday" Weapon Recipe, the Demon Storage Shelf and 10 Collectable Postcard.

A Bundle of both Chapter 1 and Chapter 2, including their Tourist and Payback upgrades, will also be arriving soon!

We hope you enjoy your return to undead New Orleans.

notes.title: Retribution is Just a Month Away!
notes.notes:
The March 21st release date for the PCVR/PSVR2 versions of [i]Retribution[/i] is rapidly approaching, and we are hard at work making sure everything is ready for that date. To give you a peak at some of the visual enhancements coming with these launches, check out the following action packed trailer!

[previewyoutube=I7Fa4qx1qLM;full][/previewyoutube]

A new patch for the Meta version of the game is also coming today, further improving the experience for current players and showing some of the even greater improvements coming alongside the new launch.

[url=https://mailchi.mp/skydance.com/a-new-hot-fix-for-retribution]Check out our newsletter for further details![/url] 

Thank you for your continued support and excitement, and we hope to see all you Tourists back in NOLA very soon.

notes.title: Retribution Release Date News and Info
notes.notes:
It's good to see you again, Tourists.

With the release of [i]The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Chapter 2: Retribution[/i] on Meta Headsets, and the launch date announced for PSVR2, players on PC have been waiting to hear news on when the PCVR version of the game would officially launch. We always try to get games in your hands as fast as possible, but sometimes we need to take our time to make sure that your game will work properly and fully utilize the features of your platform of choice. To ensure that the PCVR version of the game looks and runs at the highest possible quality, we've made the decision to move its release from December 2022 to February 2023. We discussed this some days ago, but we should have posted here as well, so sorry for the last minute nature of this post.

We thank you for your patience, and hope to see you return to undead New Orleans in early 2023.
